doc: nvfp4 W4A4 (modelopt export shapes): weight u8 [out, in/2] packed e2m1 nibble pairs, element 2j in the LOW nibble; weight_scale e4m3 [out, in/16] per-16-block scales, flat row-major; weight_scale_2 f32 scalar. Dequant: W ~= e2m1(weight) * weight_scale.float() * weight_scale_2. Detection is the (u8 weight + e4m3 weight_scale + f32 weight_scale_2) triple, never a name list. Variant roles: base+input_scale+pre_quant_scale.
